name: MedHELM
description: MedHELM is an extensible evaluation framework for assessing large language model performance on diverse medical tasks, featuring a clinician-validated taxonomy and a comprehensive suite of 35 benchmarks covering 121 tasks.
reputation: A recent, broad medical LLM evaluation framework that is gaining attention for its clinician-validated taxonomy and wide task coverage.
notes: Includes improved evaluation methods using an LLM-jury with good agreement with clinician ratings; covers real-world clinical practice complexity.
